title: Three humps, dam break (LISFLOOD-FP test T03): a reservoir drains over three hills

reference.of: Boann 6.0.0 FV1 CPU build, frozen on this deck (drift self-reference)

note: Boann and LISFLOOD-FP 8.3 FV1 agree on this deck, but the dam break over three hills is wave-dominated, so a few cells differ by ~0.2 m in peak timing between any two codes. A frozen Boann self-reference makes this a tight drift guard; external agreement with LF is checked in the Mac/cloud kit, not gated to the millimetre here.
